obligations.title: Provide the Services per Schedule 1 using qualified personnel, with reasonable skill and care.
Provide information, access and co-operation the Supplier reasonably requires to perform the Services.
Comply with the Client's notified security and site policies when accessing its premises or systems.
Keep the other Party's Confidential Information confidential and use it only for this Agreement, for 7 years after the Agreement ends.
Return or securely destroy the other Party's Confidential Information on request after termination or expiry.
Do not knowingly provide personal data to the Supplier in connection with the Services.
Agree written data protection terms before any personal data processing continues.
Attempt in good faith to resolve disputes by escalation to senior executives before starting proceedings.
